title: A box at rest on a 30° ramp

steps.say: Weight pulls the 5 kg box straight down: W = mg = 5 × 9.8 = 49 N.
The ramp pushes back perpendicular to its surface: N = mg cos 30° = 49 × 0.866 ≈ 42.4 N.
Static friction acts up the slope and cancels the downhill pull: f = mg sin 30° = 24.5 N, so the box stays put.
